overview: This table lists the decal art the game gets ready before a battle on certain stages.
description: Per-map list of decal Blueprint actor asset names that battle phases preload as Decal primary assets.

ID.simple: The stage this decal list belongs to. Changing this name connects the list to a different battle stage.
ID.technical: FName row key/import key (native Id, export label ID), not read as a row value by the consumer. BattleAssets_MapDecals_12BD690 first rejects Map::Id_MapDecal == NAME_None, then scans MapDecalDataTables (DTM +0x3C0) in table order with UDataTable::FindRow and takes the first row keyed by that name; a missing row contributes nothing. The same collector is called by StartBattleAssetPreload and UGamePhase_BattleBase::PreparePhase case 1. The only export shard has five unique rows (MAP_01, MAP_03, MAP_06, MAP_07, MAP_13), exactly the non-None MapDataTable.Id_MapDecal values.

Filename.simple: The names of decal effects the game gets ready before a battle on this stage. Empty entries are ignored.
Filename.technical: Serialized C++ property TArray<FName> FileName (export label Filename); every exported row has 16 slots, with unused trailing slots set to NAME_None and no consumer indexing by slot. The collector appends the entire array in order, including None, to a name list. GamePrimaryAssetLoader_CreateLoaders converts names to Decal FPrimaryAssetIds, but CreateLoadersForIds empties the destination and skips NAME_None and duplicate names, so only distinct real names become loaders: StudioMapDecalLoaders_1D0 in battle preload (gated by IsBattleAssetPreloaded) and StudioMapDecalLoaders_770 in BattleBase PreparePhase (gated in case 2). All 34 non-None entries across the export (26 distinct DCL_*_BP names) match a DecalDataTable FileName value, not that table's row IDs; DecalDataTable.bResident is irrelevant here. The shipped Decal primary asset rule scans /Game/Decals Blueprint subclasses of GameDecalActor_BP, and AGameRenderManager::SpawnDecal later resolves the same Decal primary asset ID to an already-loaded actor UClass. Loading fails gracefully for absent/missing classes; no map-decal row supplies a spawn transform.

notes: MapDecalDataTables is manager slot +0x3C0. StartInitialLoading registers 'MapDecalDataTable' as a DataTable primary asset (GameDataTableManager.cpp:338); after all DataTable loaders complete, Tick resolves it and AddLoadedDataTables appends only non-null tables (line 190). BattleAssets_FindRow uses first-match precedence across the tables in that array; the export contains one shard with five rows.

There are two direct runtime call sites for this row type, not one: UGamePhase::StartBattleAssetPreload looks up Level.BattleLevel with bCheckNone=true and fills StudioMapDecalLoaders_1D0 (lines 146-150, gate at 174, retained on LeavePhase at GamePhase.cpp:234), while UGamePhase_BattleBase::PreparePhase case 1 looks up StudioBattleLevelRequest_CA0.BattleLevel and fills StudioMapDecalLoaders_770 (lines 282-293, gate at 313, retained at 1070). Retail RVAs 0x12bd690 and 0xffd930 identify the reconstructed collector and loader helper.

No spawn-time reader of FGameDataTableRow_MapDecal was found. These names seed the Decal primary-asset loader/cache; the generic DecalDataTable -> AGameRenderManager::SpawnDecal path reads the same Decal primary-asset UClass, but no traced C++ maps a MapDecal row to a placement, transform, or actor. Any level/Blueprint-driven placement or activation is outside this evidence set.

Export columns ID and Filename correspond to the case-different native properties Id and FileName. Prefix correspondence with DecalDataTable (DCL_xxxxx -> DCL_xxxxx_BP) is a data convention cross-checked against its FileName column, not a row-key lookup performed by the collector.

Evidence boundary: statements come from the reconstructed C++ (with retail RVA comments), shipped Config/DefaultGame.ini, and the complete export. No individual decal Blueprint asset, cooked package, retail Blueprint dump, or runtime execution was provided, so Blueprint-only consumers and byte-identical retail behavior are not claimed.

usages.detail: Resolves the loaded 'MapDecalDataTable' primary asset into MapDecalDataTables (+0x3C0) after all DataTable loaders complete; registration is at line 338.
Retail 0x12bd690: skips NAME_None, finds the first MapDecal row keyed by Map::Id_MapDecal, and appends its FileName array (all entries, including None).
StartBattleAssetPreload creates Decal primary asset loaders from the collected names into StudioMapDecalLoaders_1D0 after a bCheckNone=true map row lookup.
IsBattleAssetPreloaded waits for those loaders; GamePhase::LeavePhase then moves them into StudioRetainedLoaders_90 (GamePhase.cpp:234).
PreparePhase case 1 repeats the map-decal collection for the active battle level and creates the separate StudioMapDecalLoaders_770 cache at line 293.
PreparePhase case 2 gates preparation on _770 load completion; RetainBattleLoaders moves the cache into StudioRetainedLoaders_90 at line 1070.
Indirect consumer of the loaded asset: SpawnDecal builds the same Decal primary asset ID from a DecalDataTable FileName and fetches the already-loaded actor class; it does not read MapDecalDataTable.
